name: IMPACT Therapeutics, Inc
summary: IMPACT Therapeutics, Inc., a biotechnology company, researches and develops synthetic lethality (SL)-based precision anti-cancer therapies in China and internationally. The company offers a product, (IMP4297) Senaparib, a PARP1/2 inhibitor that is used for 1L maintenance therapy for ovarian cancer (OC).
